note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate, soldier and worker are all described; the synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated; one index based on postmentum width in the soldier is incomplete in the OCR source and is omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to deep golden brown; antennae yellow to brown, paler than the head capsule and still paler distally; mandibles dark brown with paler bases; body white to pale yellow. Cephalic pilosity sparse, body pilosity moderate. Body length 3.0–4.0 mm. Head capsule oval, narrowed anteriorly, widest behind the middle (head length to mandible bases 0.90–1.03, maximum width 0.83–0.95, width at mandible bases 0.53–0.58 mm, maximum width/length index 0.86–0.94). Antennae 15–16-segmented; segment 2 as long as segments 3 and 4 together, segment 4 shortest; antennae broken in the type soldier, segment 3 shortest and segment 4 longer than segment 5. Postclypeus indistinctly differentiated from the frons, with a pair of setae near the apex. Labrum triangular, apex acute, longer than wide (length 0.25–0.34, width 0.25–0.34 mm). Mandibles slender, straight and weakly incurved near the apex (length 0.60–0.69 mm), shorter than the head (mandible length/head length index 0.60–0.73). Left mandible with a prominent tooth near the apex, 0.13–0.15 mm from the apex (tooth distance/mandible length index 0.21–0.25); right mandible with a small tooth near the apical third. Postmentum short, wide and arched, sides convex and narrowed anteriorly (length 0.43–0.60, maximum width 0.38–0.40 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin weakly to distinctly incised, posterior margin slightly concave (length 0.38–0.48, width 0.58–0.76 mm); mesonotum narrower with a straight or slightly incurved posterior margin; metanotum as wide as the pronotum with a nearly straight posterior margin.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Workers dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule yellow to deep reddish brown, antennae pale yellowish brown with paler bases, body cream yellow; cephalic and body pilosity relatively dense. Body length 3.4–4.1 mm. Head capsule subcircular (head length to mandible bases 0.95–1.18, maximum width 1.0–1.18 mm). Antennae 17-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus inflated and setose, slightly less than to about half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.30–0.40, width 0.50–0.63 mm), anterior margin distinctly incised, posterior margin weakly concave. Minor worker: resembling the major worker but smaller; body length 2.7–3.2 mm, head length to mandible bases 0.60–0.88, maximum head width 0.68–0.88, pronotum length 0.25–0.33, width 0.48–0.53 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown to chestnut brown; antennae, labrum, postclypeus and pronotum yellowish brown, paler than the head capsule; pronotum with a T-shaped mark in the middle and an ocellus-like spot at each anterolateral corner; wings pale brown. Cephalic and body pilosity dense, of long and short setae. Body length with wings 24.0–26.5 mm, 12.5–14.0 mm without wings. Head capsule subcircular (head length to mandible bases 1.50–1.80, maximum width including compound eyes 2.14–2.40 mm). Fontanelle small and slightly raised, preceded by another small, suboval raised spot. Compound eyes large, subcircular (maximum diameter 0.65–0.70, minimum diameter 0.55–0.65 mm), distinctly protruding and relatively larger than in other species. Ocelli large, oval (long diameter 0.30–0.38, short diameter 0.23–0.28 mm), close to the compound eyes, eye–ocellus distance 0.08–0.10 mm, about one third of the short diameter. Antennae 19-segmented, segments 3, 4 and 5 subequal. Postclypeus weakly inflated, less than half as long as wide (length 0.39–0.40, width 0.86–0.90 mm). Pronotum subtrapezoidal (length 1.03–1.20, maximum width 1.95–2.13 mm), anterior margin with a weak median notch, posterior margin weakly concave medially. Wings long and narrow, shorter than in other species (forewing length 20.0–21.3 mm); the radial sector separates near the apical third.
